newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares close mixed on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares close mixed on profit-taking.

text.p: Russian stocks closed mixed on Thursday on profit-taking in leading shares and second-tier issues, with preferred shares remaining stable, traders said.
The Russian Trading System index of 24 shares rose 0.41 percent to 192.82 on $19.19 million in volume.
The eurobond issue did not have an impact on the share market, traders said.
"Today's demand was in no way initiated by the eurobond placement," said Dmitry Starenko from Regent European Securities.
Russia launched its debut five-year $1 billion eurobond on Thursday.
The biggest rise was in oil shares, CentreInvest Securities trader Igor Volkov said.

But Nikolai Fomintsev from IATs Analyse said the rise was artificial, with brokers marking up prices but finding no Western support, after investors had seen President Boris Yeltsin on television on Wednesday.
"It was an attempt to create an illusion of a feverish demand as yesterday everyone had a chance to see Yeltsin on television," he said.
On Wednesday Yeltsin made his first public appearance after his heart operation at the beginning of the month.
He said doctors had taken out his stitches and that he was in fighting mood.
Volkov forecast a further rise in oil stocks and profit-taking later.
He forecast a fall in Gazprom in the next few days because of an expected fall in the share price at a forthcoming auction.
"We are in for a big fall," he said.
The next auction will be held on November 27 when shares will be offered at a starting price of 1,968 roubles a share.
Volkov forecast the average price at the auction would be between 1,600 and 1,700 roubles and that this would be reflected on the secondary market.
Gazprom fell to an average 2,071.44 roubles a share at the auction on Wednesday, down from 2,180.25 roubles at the previous auction.
Gazprom fell to $0.337 from $0.344 at Wednesday's close, Permenergo rose to $23.05 from $19.40, Norilsk Nickel edged down to $6.11 from $6.22 and UES was $0.0830 after $0.0832.
